facts.text: The hotel was built in 1857 by architect Enrico Marconi.
facts.excerpt: Raffles Europejski Warsaw was built in 1857 by Enrico Marconi

facts.text: The hotel has been restored and restyled.
facts.excerpt: Having been lovingly restored and restyled to reflect the needs of today

facts.text: The hotel holds a collection of 500 modern and contemporary artworks by more than 120 artists.
facts.excerpt: Home to a collection of 500 modern and contemporary artworks by over 120 artists

facts.text: The Immersive Art Retreat package includes a private tour guided by the hotel's Art Collection Manager.
facts.excerpt: On your two-night stay, enjoy a private tour guided by our Art Collection Manager, and take home the souvenir album.

facts.text: Lourse Warszawa is a reinvention of the patisserie where Warsaw society met over tea and confections in the early 20th century.
facts.excerpt: In the early 20th century, the cream of Warsaw society met over tea and exquisite confections at Lourse Warszawa.

facts.text: Europejski Grill reinterprets Polish culinary heritage through a modern European lens.
facts.excerpt: A signature restaurant where Polish culinary heritage is reinterpreted through a modern European lens.

facts.text: Long Bar Warsaw's cocktails are inspired by the Raffles Long Bar in Singapore.
facts.excerpt: The Long Bar features a dazzling selection of cocktails, inspired by the famous Raffles Long Bar in Singapore

facts.text: The Humidor is a salon for cigars and rare spirits.
facts.excerpt: An intimate salon for cigars and rare spirits, designed for quiet conversation and unhurried evenings.

facts.text: Europejski Grill Terrace offers seasonal al fresco dining with Mediterranean flavours.
facts.excerpt: Seasonal al fresco dining shaped by Mediterranean flavours and a refined sense of place.

facts.text: Raffles Spa uses Aromatherapy Associates and Sisley products.
facts.excerpt: Raffles Spa features bespoke rejuvenating treatments using Aromatherapy Associates and Sisley products, inspired by Asian, Middle Eastern and European traditions.

facts.text: The spa has an indoor pool.
facts.excerpt: Facilities include six soothing treatment rooms and a state-of-the-art upstream indoor pool.

facts.text: The hotel has a gym with optional personal training.
facts.excerpt: a state-of-the-art gym with optional personal training

facts.text: Children under 16 may use the pool only during set daytime hours and when accompanied and supervised by a parent or guardian.
facts.excerpt: Children under the age of 16 are warmly welcomed to enjoy the pool between 10.00am and 6.00pm, when accompanied and supervised by a parent or guardian.

facts.text: Each room comes with personalized service from Raffles Butlers.
facts.excerpt: Each room features handcrafted furniture, luxurious fabrics, and personalized service from Raffles Butlers.

facts.text: Suite stays include welcome champagne on arrival and 24-hour Raffles butler service.
facts.excerpt: including welcome champagne on arrival and 24-hour Raffles butler service

facts.text: The Prestige Suite has a separate oval living room with views of the Saxon Gardens and the Warsaw skyline.
facts.excerpt: with separate oval living room and wonderful views of Saxon Gardens and the Warsaw city skyline

facts.text: Rooms blend design with contemporary Polish art.
facts.excerpt: They blend design and contemporary Polish art and offer a wide range of amenities.

facts.text: The hotel is on Warsaw's Royal Route.
facts.excerpt: Step off the Royal Route and into our immersive living gallery

facts.text: The hotel's address is Krakowskie Przedmiescie 13 in Warsaw.
facts.excerpt: Raffles Spa is conveniently located at Krakowskie Przedmieście 13, 00-071, Warsaw

facts.text: Private dining menus are curated by Executive Chef Rene Guttzeit.
facts.excerpt: Bespoke menu curated by Executive Chef René Guttzeit

facts.text: The restaurant menu includes a variety of vegetarian dishes.
facts.excerpt: Yes, the menu includes a variety of vegetarian dishes

facts.text: The hotel describes the Europejski Royal Suite as the finest Warsaw has to offer.
facts.excerpt: Europejski Royal Suite is elegant and prestigious, the finest Warsaw has to offer.
